About The Role  



Project Role :LLM Operations Engineer




Project Role Description :Utilize cloud-native services and tools for scalable and efficient deployment. Monitor LLM performance, address operational challenges, and ensure compliance and security standards in AI operations.


Must have skills :Large Language Models (LLMs)



Good to have skills :Prompt Engineering, Generative AI
Minimum 2 year(s) of experience is required



Educational Qualification :15 years full time education



Summary:
As an LLM Operations Engineer, you will engage in a dynamic work environment where you will utilize cloud-native services and tools for scalable and efficient deployment. Your typical day will involve monitoring the performance of large language models, addressing operational challenges, and ensuring compliance with security standards in AI operations. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance operational efficiency and contribute to the overall success of AI initiatives.

Roles & Responsibilities:
- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Assist in the development and implementation of best practices for LLM operations.
- Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to optimize model performance.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs).
Good To Have Skills:
- Experience with Prompt Engineering, Generative AI.
- Strong understanding of cloud-native services and deployment strategies.
- Familiarity with monitoring tools for performance assessment.
- Knowledge of compliance and security standards in AI operations.


Additional Information:
- The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).
- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.



 Qualification
 15 years full time education

Project Role :LLM Model Developer


Project Role Description :Fine-tunes Large Language Models with emphasis on instruction fine-tuning and domain adaptation to enhance model relevance and performance in specific contexts.
Must have skills :Large Language Models

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary:As a LLM Model Developer, you will engage in the fine-tuning of Large Language Models, focusing on instruction fine-tuning and domain adaptation. Your typical day will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance model relevance and performance in specific contexts, ensuring that the models meet the diverse needs of various applications. You will analyze model outputs, iterate on training processes, and implement strategies to improve the overall effectiveness of the models in real-world scenarios. Your role will also include staying updated with the latest advancements in the field to continuously refine and innovate the model development process.
Roles Responsibilities:
Expected to be an SME.
Collaborate and manage the team to perform.
Responsible for team decisions.
Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
Mentor junior team members to enhance their skills and knowledge in model development.
Conduct regular assessments of model performance and suggest improvements based on findings. Professional Technical Skills:Must To Have Skills:Proficiency in Large Language Models.
Strong understanding of natural language processing techniques.
Experience with model evaluation metrics and performance tuning.
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python and frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Ability to work with large datasets and implement data preprocessing techniques.
Additional Information:
The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Large Language Models.
This position is based at our Bengaluru office.

Apex Group Ltd is a global financial services provider headquartered in Bermuda (founded in 2003), offering fund administration, corporate services, ESG solutions, and digital banking. It operates in over 52 countries with more than 13,000 employees.




Job Location - Pune / Bangalore

Cab Facility- Yes

Role- AI Solution Engineer

Exp- 4 to 8 yr

Job Summary

Owns the model lifecycle strategy underpinning the agent ecosystem: model selection, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment automation, and cost/performance optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Own model selection and fine-tuning strategy across the agent portfolio, balancing quality, cost, and latency.
Design and maintain robust MLOps pipelines for training, evaluation, versioning, and rollback of models.
Establish production monitoring for model drift, degradation, and safety metrics.
Partner with Agentic Engineers and Prompt Engineers to diagnose whether issues are model-level or prompt/orchestration-level.
Lead capacity planning and cost-optimization initiatives for model inference at scale.
Mentor Associate-level engineers and set MLOps best practices.

Required Qualifications

4-7 years of experience in ML engineering/MLOps,.
Strong expertise in model training frameworks, distributed training/inference, and evaluation methodology.
Experience with production ML infrastructure (Kubernetes, model-serving frameworks, feature/vector stores).
Track record of optimizing model cost/latency/quality trade-offs at scale.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and reinforcement-learning-based alignment techniques.
Including production fine-tuning and deployment of LLMs
Experience in a regulated industry with model-risk-management requirements.

Core Competencies

Technical leadership
Operational excellence
Cost/performance judgment
Mentorship

Project Role :LLM Full Stack Engineer


Project Role Description :Develop and integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) and other enterprise services. Leverage front-end and server-side technologies to develop APIs, implement DevOps practices, and optimize Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications.
Must have skills :Python Frameworks, Machine Learning (ML), Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary:
As an LLM Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing and building applications that seamlessly integrate Large Language Models with various enterprise systems. The role requires balancing front-end and back-end development tasks, creating robust application programming interfaces, and ensuring smooth deployment through DevOps methodologies. The engineer continuously works to enhance the performance and scalability of artificial intelligence solutions, collaborating with diverse teams to align technical implementations with business objectives. This dynamic environment fosters innovation and problem-solving to deliver cutting-edge AI-driven applications.

Roles Responsibilities:
- Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
- Lead the design and implementation of scalable AI applications ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
- Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team to foster continuous learning and development.
- Coordinate cross-functional efforts to integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise platforms.

Professional Technical Skills:
- Experience in Python development
- Strong in Fast APIs.,numpy, Pandas,Django etc
- Hands-on with Databricks and PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server), SQL, and ORMs (Hibernate).
- Build/CI/CD:Maven/Gradle, Git, pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions/Jenkins).
- Containers:Docker basic Kubernetes skills (deployment, config maps, secrets).
- Familiarity with API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) and JSON/REST standards.
- Solid understanding of software design patterns, clean code, and domain-driven design fundamentals.
- Cloud:Microsoft Azure (App Service, AKS, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Storage, Application Insights).
- Messaging/Streaming:Kafka/RabbitMQ asynchronous processing
- Caching:Redis, Spring Cache.
- Security:OAuth2/OIDC with Azure AD JWT token management.


Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in Python Frameworks, Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI.
- Strong experience in developing and deploying APIs using Python-based frameworks.
- In-depth understanding of server-side technologies and their integration with AI models.
- Familiarity with DevOps practices including continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines.
- Ability to optimize AI applications for performance, scalability, and reliability.
- Experience working with cloud platforms and containerization technologies to support AI workloads.
- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Python Frameworks.
- This position is based at our Pune office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.




Qualification
15 years full time education
